prompt: 一张黑白手写体文字海报，纯黑背景，白色字母。画面中央以紧凑的单块形式堆叠三行文字，字体均为粗重连笔手写体（Brush script），笔画厚实且流畅。第一行文字为“Trust”，字体极大，字母连笔，笔画向右侧倾斜，首字母为大写；第二行文字为“your”，字体同样极大，笔画向右侧倾斜；第三行文字为“Pace”，字体较大，笔画连笔。三行文字的字号大小基本一致。每行文字的末尾都带有长长的平行四边形尾笔（Swash），笔画末端水平延伸。画面中仅包含这三行文字，无其他文字、图案或装饰，整体为纯黑白色调，无描边、无阴影、无渐变。构图简洁，文字居中，四周留有大面积的黑色空白区域。

A black and white brush script quote poster, portrait. Solid black background, white lettering. Three stacked lines in one tight block in the center: "Trust" in very large heavy connected brush script with thick smooth strokes, leaning to the right, with a big capital; "your" in very large heavy connected brush script with thick smooth strokes, leaning to the right; "Pace" in heavy connected brush script. All the words are about the same size. The last letter of each line ends in a long flat horizontal swash. Only these three words, no other text, pure black and white, no other colors, no outline, no shadow, hand-lettered style, wide empty black margins.
